daas-irab:25-26.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَدْعُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلى دارِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يدعو. ﴿السَّلامِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَهْدِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يدعو [Translator's note: so in the source; the attachment is evidently to يهدي]. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: the lām is a preposition, and the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by it; the two are attached to the fronted predicate. ﴿أَحْسَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الْحُسْنى﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur); الحسنى is Paradise. ﴿وَزِيادَةٌ﴾: maʿṭūf on الحسنى; the clause is resumptive. The "increase" (الزيادة) is the beholding of the Face of Allah the Magnificent. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿يَرْهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمْ قَتَرٌ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿ذِلَّةٌ﴾: maʿṭūf on قتر. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:27-30.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَسَبُوا السَّيِّئاتِ﴾: a past verb; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and السيئات is its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿جَزاءُ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿سَيِّئَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِمِثْلِها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); this clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَتَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is in the position of the genitive by مِن; the two are attached to عاصم. ﴿مِنَ﴾: redundant (zāʾida). ﴿عاصِمٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿كَأَنَّما﴾: the restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained particle (makfūfa). ﴿أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعاً﴾: a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of قطعا. ﴿مُظْلِماً﴾: a second adjective; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: khabar. ﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and يوم is an adverb of time attached to an omitted verb. ﴿نَحْشُرُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun made genitive by the lām; the two are attached to نقول. ﴿أَشْرَكُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَكانَكُمْ﴾: a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr). ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in مكانكم. ﴿وَشُرَكاؤُكُمْ﴾: conjoined to أنتم. ﴿فَزَيَّلْنا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to زيلنا [Translator's note: so in the source; بين is normally parsed as an adverb of place]; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقالَ شُرَكاؤُهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِيَّانا﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi of تعبدون. ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿فَكَفى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant, and the Name of Majesty is genitive in form and nominative in position as fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾: an adverb of place attached to شهيد; نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾: conjoined to بيننا. ﴿إِنْ﴾: lightened from إنّ and inoperative (muhmala). ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna, and نا is its noun; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَنْ عِبادَتِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غافلين. ﴿لَغافِلِينَ﴾: the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and the khabar, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿هُنالِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, an adverb of place; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿تَبْلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness. ﴿كُلُّ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَسْلَفَتْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَرُدُّوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ردوا. ﴿مَوْلاهُمُ﴾: badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: badal. ﴿وَضَلَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضل. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:31-32.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَرْزُقُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرزقكم. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on السماء. ﴿أم﴾: a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَمْلِكُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿السَّمْعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْأَبْصارَ﴾: maʿṭūf on السمع. ﴿وَمَنْ يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يخرج. ﴿وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar; and the clause of من .. 0 is conjoined [Translator's note: "من.. 0" is reproduced as it stands in the source text]. ﴿فَسَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو الله"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَقُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lā is negating. ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَذلِكُمُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكُمُ﴾: badal (substitute); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: badal, or an adjective (ṣifa) of رب. ﴿فَماذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, mā is negating, and dhā is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الضَّلالُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and أنّى is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تُصْرَفُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:33-35.t: ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the kāf; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to حقت. ﴿فَسَقُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun; anna and what follows it are in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. "after their faith" (بعد إيمانهم) [Translator's note: so in the source]. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb is active and the wāw is its fāʿil], and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿مِنْ شُرَكائِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the Quranic word is مَنْ]: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يُعِيدُهُ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on يبدأ; the hāʾ is its object. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿يَبْدَؤُا﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿الْخَلْقَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and أنّى is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تُؤْفَكُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكائِكُمْ مَنْ﴾: their i'rab has preceded shortly before. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَى الْحَقِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يهدي; the clause is the khabar of من, and the speech is the object of the saying. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿لِلْحَقِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يهدي. ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, and مَن is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَى الْحَقِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يهدي. ﴿أَحَقُّ﴾: the khabar of من. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a subjunctive-governing particle. ﴿يُتَّبَعَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition. ﴿أم﴾: a conjunction. ﴿مِنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the Quranic word is مَنْ]: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: subjunctive-governing. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility; the nāʾib fāʿil is latent, and the interpreted maṣdar from an and what follows it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: the source analyses the word as the passive يُهْدَى, though it prints the Quranic word as ﴿يَهْدِي﴾]. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and mā is interrogative, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿تَحْكُمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the preceding clause.

daas-irab:36-38.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ظَنًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّ الظَّنَّ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُغْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ الْحَقِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾: the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the two are attached to عليم. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿كانَ هذَا﴾: kāna, and a demonstrative as its noun; the hāʾ [Translator's note: the source writes «الها»] is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْقُرْآنُ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿أَنْ﴾: subjunctive-governing. ﴿يُفْتَرى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being an implied fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, and the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يفترى. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿تَصْدِيقَ﴾: the khabar of an omitted kāna whose noun is omitted, the implied form being "كان تصديق"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: the relative noun is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿وَتَفْصِيلَ﴾: maʿṭūf on تصديق. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation. ﴿رَيْبَ﴾: the noun of lā. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated as a sound masculine plural. ﴿أم﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿افْتَراهُ﴾: a past verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِسُورَةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أتوا. ﴿مِثْلِهِ﴾: an adjective of سورة; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَادْعُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنِ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اسْتَطَعْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: khabar, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:39-41.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and mā is relative; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا. ﴿لَمْ﴾: jussive-governing. ﴿يُحِيطُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِعِلْمِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحيطوا. ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and لما is a jussive-governing particle. ﴿يَأْتِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَأْوِيلُهُ﴾: fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb, and a relative noun as fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the mafʿūl bihi of انظر. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُؤْمِنُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمن; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿وَرَبُّكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾: khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and المفسدين a genitive noun; the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and in is conditional. ﴿كَذَّبُوكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَقُلْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿لِي﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿عَمَلِي﴾: mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel suited to it; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلَكُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿عَمَلُكُمْ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿بَرِيئُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: composed of the preposition مِن and the relative mā; the two are attached to بريئون. ﴿أَعْمَلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:42-44.t: ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾: the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَسْتَمِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يستمعون. ﴿أَفَأَنْتَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تُسْمِعُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الصُّمَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the speech is maʿṭūf (conjoined) on what preceded. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ﴾: their i'rab has preceded shortly before. ﴿يَنْظُرُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينظر. ﴿أَفَأَنْتَ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَلَوْ كانُوا لا يُبْصِرُونَ﴾: see the i'rab of the preceding verse. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يَظْلِمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, standing in for the absolute object). ﴿وَلكِنَّ النَّاسَ﴾: lākinna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of lākinna.

daas-irab:45-46.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and يوم is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "واذكر" ("and remember"); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَحْشُرُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَأَنْ﴾: lightened from كأنّ; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam through the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ساعَةً﴾: an adverb of time attached to يلبثوا. ﴿مِنَ النَّهارِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ساعة. ﴿يَتَعارَفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to يتعارفون. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مُهْتَدِينَ﴾: the khabar of كانوا. ﴿وَإِمَّا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إمّا is composed of the conditional in and the redundant (zāʾida) mā. ﴿نُرِيَنَّكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause of the protasis is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); the fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَعْضَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَعِدُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent and the kāf is its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِلَيْنا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَرْجِعُهُمْ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ and شهيد the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى ما﴾: the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by على, and the two are attached to شهيد. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:47-49.t: ﴿وَلِكُلِّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿جاءَ رَسُولُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُضِيَ﴾: a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to قضي; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial and هم is a mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَتى﴾: an interrogative noun of time, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿هذَا﴾: the hāʾ [Translator's note: the source writes «الها»] is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الْوَعْدُ﴾: badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: the khabar of كنتم, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿أَمْلِكُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لِنَفْسِي﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أملك; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ضَرًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا نَفْعاً﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on ضرا. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative, excepted (mustathnā) by إلا. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَجَلٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿جاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of إذا, and lā is negating. ﴿يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿ساعَةً﴾: an adverb of time attached to يستأخرون. ﴿وَلا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ﴾: conjoined to يستأخرون.

daas-irab:50-52.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿أَتاكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fronted object. ﴿عَذابُهُ﴾: its postponed fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَياتاً﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) أتاكم. ﴿أَوْ نَهاراً﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on بياتا. ﴿ماذا﴾: mā is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and dhā is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position, because it is not joined with the fāʾ that links the apodosis. ﴿يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستعجل. ﴿أَثُمَّ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and thumma is a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿ما﴾: redundant (zāʾida). ﴿وَقَعَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنتم. ﴿آلْآنَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and الآن is an adverb of time. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تستعجلون. ﴿تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كنتم. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿قِيلَ﴾: a passive past verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: a relative in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to قيل. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ذُوقُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of قيل. ﴿عَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْخُلْدِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿تُجْزَوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾: the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the two are attached to تجزون [Translator's note: so in the source, although no bāʾ appears in the text; it presumably assumes an omitted bāʾ (بما)]. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تَكْسِبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:53-54.t: ﴿وَيَسْتَنْبِئُونَكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its first object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَحَقٌّ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿هُوَ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of the accusative as second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِي﴾: a particle of answer with no grammatical position. ﴿وَرَبِّي﴾: the wāw is a preposition of oath, and ربي is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb أقسم ("I swear"), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَحَقٌّ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and حق is the khabar of إنه. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā operates like laysa. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: the noun of mā. ﴿بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and معجزين is the khabar of mā, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ظَلَمَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of نفس. ﴿ما﴾: relative, the postponed noun of inna [Translator's note: so in the source, «اسم إن»; the particle in the verse is أنّ]. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿لَافْتَدَتْ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to افتدت; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدامَةَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿لَمَّا﴾: the temporal لما (al-ḥīniyya), an adverb of time attached to أسروا; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَأَوُا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقُضِيَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: attached to قضي; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

daas-irab:55-58.t: ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, the noun of inna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on السموات. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of drawing attention. ﴿إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar; the Name of Majesty is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the clause confirms what preceded. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lākinna and its noun; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُحيِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَيُمِيتُ﴾: maʿṭūf on يحيي. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction [Translator's note: the source says nothing further about إليه]. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; the vocative clause has no grammatical position. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾: badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَتْكُمْ﴾: a past verb; the kāf is its object, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿مَوْعِظَةٌ﴾: postponed fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to موعظة. ﴿وَشِفاءٌ﴾: maʿṭūf on موعظة. ﴿لِما﴾: mā is a relative noun made genitive by the lām; the two are attached to شفاء. ﴿فِي الصُّدُورِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شفاء. ﴿وَهُدىً وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رحمة. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِفَضْلِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "فليفرحوا بفضل" ("let them rejoice in the bounty"). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ﴾: conjoined to بفضل. ﴿فَبِذلِكَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to يفرحوا; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿فَلْيَفْرَحُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined to the omitted فليفرحوا. ﴿هُوَ خَيْرٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: the relative mā, with مِن assimilated into it; the two are attached to خير. ﴿يَجْمَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:59-60.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ما﴾: relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل. ﴿مِنْ رِزْقٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَجَعَلْتُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جعلتم. ﴿حَلالًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَحَراماً﴾: maʿṭūf on حلالا. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَذِنَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أذن. ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by على; the two are attached to تفترون. ﴿تَفْتَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mā is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ظَنُّ﴾: khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يفترون. ﴿الْكَذِبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to ظن. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿لَذُو﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ذو is the khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فضل. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: lākinna and its noun; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يَشْكُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:61-63.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿تَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun of تكون is usually taken to be the latent pronoun "you"]. ﴿فِي شَأْنٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿تَتْلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تتلو. ﴿مِنْ﴾: redundant (zāʾida). ﴿قُرْآنٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the verse is lā]. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ﴾: redundant. ﴿عَمَلٍ﴾: genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كُنَّا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شهودا. ﴿شُهُوداً﴾: khabar. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to شهودا. ﴿تُفِيضُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تفيضون. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and lā is negating [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the verse is mā]. ﴿يَعْزُبُ﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿عَنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعزب. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant preposition. ﴿مِثْقالِ﴾: fāʿil, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿ذَرَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا فِي السَّماءِ﴾: maʿṭūf on في الأرض. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lā is redundant. ﴿أَصْغَرَ﴾: maʿṭūf on مثقال, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿مِنْ ذلِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by مِن; the two are attached to أصغر; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lā is redundant. ﴿أَكْبَرَ﴾: maʿṭūf on أصغر. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the mubtadaʾ (subject) is omitted, its implied form being "هو في كتاب"; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of opening (istiftāḥ). ﴿إِنَّ أَوْلِياءَ﴾: inna [and] its noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿خَوْفٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَحْزَنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of هم. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم". ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكانُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:64-66.t: [Translator's note: at the start of this entry the source text is damaged: the opening brackets and first letters of the Quranic words are lost. The words are restored here in brackets from the verse.] ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْبُشْرى﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to البشرى. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation, operating like inna. ﴿تَبْدِيلَ﴾: the noun of lā, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿لِكَلِماتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْفَوْزُ﴾: its khabar. ﴿الْعَظِيمُ﴾: an adjective of الفوز. ﴿وَلا﴾: a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive (nāhiya). ﴿يَحْزُنْكَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿قَوْلُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾: two khabars. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, the noun of lā [Translator's note: so in the source; it is the noun of inna]. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿يَتَّبِعُ الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يدعون; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شُرَكاءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يتبع. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is إِنْ]: negating. ﴿يَتَّبِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَلا﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is إِلَّا]: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الظَّنَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and in is negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلا﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is إِلَّا]: a particle of restriction. ﴿يَخْرُصُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:67-70.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: the relative noun is the khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعل. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِتَسْكُنُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the lām and what follows it are attached to جعل. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تسكنوا. ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on الليل. ﴿مُبْصِراً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by في; the two are attached to the fronted khabar; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the noun of inna, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آيات. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿وَلَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ and postponed khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾: relative, a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf on السموات. ﴿إِنْ﴾: negating. ﴿عِنْدَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition with no governing effect. ﴿سُلْطانٍ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿بِهذا﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ذا a demonstrative; the two are attached to سلطان; the hāʾ [Translator's note: the source writes «الها»] is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿أَتَقُولُونَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty; the two are attached to تقولون. ﴿ما﴾: relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by على; the two are attached to يفترون. ﴿الْكَذِبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُفْلِحُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿مَتاعٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being "لهم متاع". ﴿قليل﴾ [Translator's note: this word is not in the verse (10:70 reads مَتاعٌ فِي الدُّنْيا); it is reproduced as it stands in the source]: an adjective. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to متاع; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَرْجِعُهُمْ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نُذِيقُهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the hāʾ is its first object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الشَّدِيدَ﴾: an adjective. ﴿بِما﴾: mā is maṣdariyya, and it and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the preposition bāʾ; the two are attached to نذيقهم. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:71-72.t: ﴿وَاتْلُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اتل. ﴿نَبَأَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿نُوحٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to نبأ. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قال. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which has been dropped for lightness; the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is a latent pronoun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿كَبُرَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كبر. ﴿مَقامِي﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَذْكِيرِي﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on مقامي. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تذكيري. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَعَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by على; the two are attached to توكلت. ﴿تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فَأَجْمِعُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; أجمعوا here is an imperative verb]. ﴿أَمْرَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَشُرَكاءَكُمْ﴾: maʿṭūf on أمركم, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾: negating [Translator's note: so in the source; lā here is prohibitive (nāhiya), which is why the verb is jussive]. ﴿يَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā. ﴿أَمْرَكُمْ﴾ [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the word in the verse is أَمْرُكُمْ]: the noun of يكن; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غمة. ﴿غُمَّةً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of يكن. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿اقْضُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to اجمعوا. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اقضوا. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تُنْظِرُونِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the first person has been dropped; it is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and in is conditional; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَوَلَّيْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and mā is negating. ﴿سَأَلْتُكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿أَجْرٍ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle [Translator's note: so in the source; إنْ here is negating]. ﴿أَجْرِيَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَأُمِرْتُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb; the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is أَنْ]: subjunctive-governing. ﴿أَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative by an; its noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of أمرت.

daas-irab:73-74.t: ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَنَجَّيْناهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and مَن is a relative noun conjoined to the object of نجيناه. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِي الْفُلْكِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نجيناه. ﴿وَجَعَلْناهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿خَلائِفَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَأَغْرَقْنَا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا; نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of انظر. ﴿الْمُنْذَرِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿بَعَثْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بعثنا; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رُسُلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءوهم [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase is usually attached to بعثنا]. ﴿فَجاؤُهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿لِيُؤْمِنُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of denial; the lām and what follows it are attached to an omitted khabar of كانوا. ﴿بِما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to يؤمنوا. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive; the two are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نَطْبَعُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى قُلُوبِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نطبع. ﴿الْمُعْتَدِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:75-77.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿بَعَثْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) بعثنا; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُوسى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَهارُونَ﴾: maʿṭūf on موسى. ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بعثنا. ﴿وَمَلَائِهِ﴾: maʿṭūf on فرعون. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna [and] its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَوْماً﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿مُجْرِمِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural [Translator's note: so in the source; as an adjective of قوما it is accusative with the yāʾ]. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the temporal لما (al-ḥīniyya) is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِنا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءهم. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّ هذا لَسِحْرٌ﴾: inna, and the demonstrative is its noun; the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and سحر is the khabar; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: an adjective. ﴿قالَ مُوسى﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَتَقُولُونَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and تقولون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لِلْحَقِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تقولون. ﴿لَمَّا﴾: the temporal لما, an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the kāf is its object, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَسِحْرٌ هذا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a fronted khabar; the demonstrative is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ [Translator's note: the source writes «الها»] is for drawing attention (tanbīh); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and lā is negating. ﴿يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:78-80.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَجِئْتَنا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لِتَلْفِتَنا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause; نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئتنا. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: عن is a preposition and mā a relative noun; the two are attached to تلفتنا. ﴿وَجَدْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وجدنا. ﴿آباءَنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَكُونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿لَكُمَا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْكِبْرِياءُ﴾: the noun of تكون. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and mā operates like laysa. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: the noun of mā. ﴿لَكُمَا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مؤمنين. ﴿بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and مؤمنين is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of mā. ﴿وَقالَ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ائْتُونِي﴾: an imperative verb; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is its object. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ائتوني; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ساحِرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيمٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the temporal لما (al-ḥīniyya) is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ السَّحَرَةُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ لَهُمْ مُوسى﴾: a past verb, and موسى is its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال. ﴿أَلْقُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾: relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:81-82.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the temporal لما (al-ḥīniyya) is an adverb of time. ﴿أَلْقَوْا﴾: a past verb; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالَ مُوسى﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of لما. ﴿ما﴾: relative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جِئْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئتم. ﴿السِّحْرُ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of mā. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is the khabar of mā ... [Translator's note: so in the source]. ﴿سَيُبْطِلُهُ﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُصْلِحُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَمَلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَيُحِقُّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil, nominative. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿بِكَلِماتِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحق. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:83-84.t: ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿آمَنَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿لِمُوسى﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمن. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ذُرِّيَّةٌ﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of آمن. ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ذرية; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلى خَوْفٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمن. ﴿مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خوف. ﴿وَ 1 مَلَائِهِمْ﴾ [Translator's note: so printed in the source, with a stray "1"; the word in the verse is وَمَلَائِهِمْ]: the wāw is a conjunction, and ملئه is maʿṭūf (conjoined) on فرعون; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ﴾: subjunctive-governing. ﴿يَفْتِنَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), on the assumption that the lām has been omitted, i.e. "for the sake of his tormenting them" (لأجل أن يفتنهم). ﴿وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna and its noun. ﴿لَعالٍ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and عال is the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the dropped yāʾ; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عال. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَمِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾: the shifted lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَقالَ مُوسى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct (muḍāf), accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which has been dropped for lightness; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ; the two are attached to آمنتم. ﴿فَعَلَيْهِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توكلوا. ﴿تَوَكَّلُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is initial. ﴿مُسْلِمِينَ﴾: khabar, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:85-87.t: ﴿فَقالُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by على; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) توكلنا. ﴿تَوَكَّلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb); نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا تَجْعَلْنا﴾: lā is prohibitive (nāhiya), and تجعلنا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; نا is its first object and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause, together with what precedes it, is the object of the saying. ﴿فِتْنَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِلْقَوْمِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فتنة. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَنَجِّنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; نا is mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نجنا. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: an adjective, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَأَوْحَيْنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلى مُوسى﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أوحينا. ﴿وَأَخِيهِ﴾: maʿṭūf on موسى, genitive with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿أَنْ﴾: maṣdariyya. ﴿تَبَوَّءا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil; an and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of أوحينا. ﴿لِقَوْمِكُما﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبوءا. ﴿بِمِصْرَ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and مصر is genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote; the two are attached to تبوءا. ﴿بُيُوتاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and المؤمنين is its object, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:88-89.t: ﴿وَقالَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is muḍāf, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿آتَيْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَمَلَأَهُ﴾: conjoined to فرعون; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿زِينَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَمْوالًا﴾: conjoined to زينة. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آتيت. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿لِيُضِلُّوا﴾: the lām is for cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to آتيت. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضلوا; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed with an omitted vocative particle, accusative; نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اطْمِسْ﴾: a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ) whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلى أَمْوالِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اطمس; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the object of the saying. ﴿وَاشْدُدْ عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya) and lā is negating. ﴿يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation, and its fāʿil. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and preposition. ﴿يَرَوُا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after حتى; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْأَلِيمَ﴾: an adjective. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أُجِيبَتْ دَعْوَتُكُما﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَاسْتَقِيما﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive (nāhiya). ﴿تَتَّبِعانِّ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil, and the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَبِيلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: lā is negating, and يعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.

daas-irab:90-91.t: ﴿وَجاوَزْنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِبَنِي﴾: a noun genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is treated as a sound masculine plural; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاوزنا. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿الْبَحْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: a postponed fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَجُنُودُهُ﴾: conjoined to فرعون. ﴿بَغْياً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَعَدْواً﴾: conjoined to بغيا. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَدْرَكَهُ الْغَرَقُ﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿آمَنْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾: its noun; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أنه. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, the khabar of lā. ﴿آمَنْتُ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنت. ﴿بَنُوا﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is treated as a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and أنا is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿آلْآنَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and الآن is an adverb of time attached to an omitted verb. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿عَصَيْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾: an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation. ﴿وَكُنْتَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar.

daas-irab:92-93.t: ﴿فَالْيَوْمَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and اليوم is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ننجيك. ﴿نُنَجِّيكَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِبَدَنِكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Translator's note: so in the source]. ﴿لِتَكُونَ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: the lām is a preposition and مَن a relative noun; the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿خَلْفَكَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آيَةً﴾: the khabar (predicate) of تكون. ﴿وَإِنَّ كَثِيراً﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna and its noun. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كثيرا. ﴿عَنْ آياتِنا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غافلون; نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَغافِلُونَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and a khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿بَوَّأْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the answer to an oath. ﴿بَنِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is treated as a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿مُبَوَّأَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿صِدْقٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَرَزَقْناهُمْ﴾: the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined); a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رزقناهم. ﴿فَمَا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and preposition. ﴿جاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَقْضِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to يقضي; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to يقضي. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِيما﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقضي. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يختلفون. ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:94-97.t: ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and in is conditional. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فِي شَكٍّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِمَّا﴾: the relative mā, made genitive by مِن; the two are attached to an omitted adjective of شك. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزلنا. ﴿فَسْئَلِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَقْرَؤُنَ الْكِتابَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn;
