the wāw is its fāʿil and الكتاب its object; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām is for the oath and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَكَ الْحَقُّ﴾: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive (nāhiya). ﴿تَكُونَنَّ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive; its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ المُمْتَرِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُونَنَّ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; it is in the position of the jussive, its noun is a latent pronoun, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by مِن; the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَتَكُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation; its noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is the noun of inna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَقَّتْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حقت. ﴿كَلِمَتُ﴾: the fāʿil of حقت. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿جاءَتْهُمْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the hāʾ is its fronted object. ﴿كُلُّ﴾: a postponed fāʿil. ﴿آيَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and preposition. ﴿يَرَوُا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after حتى. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْأَلِيمَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:98-99.t: ﴿فَلَوْلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿كانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ﴾: kāna here is complete (tāmma); the tāʾ is for the feminine, and قرية is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿آمَنَتْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَنَفَعَها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fronted object. ﴿إِيمانُها﴾: a postponed fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿قَوْمَ﴾: excepted (mustathnā) by إلا. ﴿يُونُسَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿لَمَّا﴾: the temporal لما (al-ḥīniyya), an adverb of time. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَشَفْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كشفنا. ﴿عَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْخِزْيِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿وَمَتَّعْناهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى حِينٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to متعناهم. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَآمَنَ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of law, and a past verb. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كُلُّهُمْ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of من. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿أَفَأَنْتَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿تُكْرِهُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of cause (taʿlīl) and preposition. ﴿يَكُونُوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after حتى; the wāw is its noun. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the khabar of يكونوا.

daas-irab:100-100.t: ﴿وَما كانَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِنَفْسٍ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ﴾: an is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle. ﴿تُؤْمِنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the nominative as the postponed noun of kāna. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تؤمن. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَجْعَلُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يَجْعَلُ الرِّجْسَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir), and its object; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجعل. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.

daas-irab:101-101.t: ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت). ﴿انْظُرُوا﴾: an imperative verb; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ماذا﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿تُغْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb. ﴿الْآياتُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿وَالنُّذُرُ﴾: a conjoined noun. ﴿عَنْ قَوْمٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تغني. The clause تغني is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:102-102.t: ﴿فَهَلْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿هل﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿يَنْتَظِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِثْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَيَّامِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿خَلَوْا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the dropped alif; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلوا. The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the clause ﴿فَهَلْ يَنْتَظِرُونَ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb. ﴿فَانْتَظِرُوا﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna, and the yāʾ is its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place. The clause ﴿فَانْتَظِرُوا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause ﴿إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ﴾ is the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:103-103.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نُنَجِّي رُسُلَنا﴾: an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun conjoined to رسلنا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وذا﴾: a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿حَقًّا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) حقا. ﴿نُنْجِ﴾: an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is omitted. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: its object.

daas-irab:104-104.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ﴾: الناس is a badal (substitute) of the one addressed (munādā) before it. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿فِي شَكٍّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ دِينِي﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of شك. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿أَعْبُدُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "I" (أنا). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تعبدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لكِنْ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿أَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is its object and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَأُمِرْتُ﴾: a passive past verb; the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَنْ أَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); its noun is omitted, its implied form being "I" (أنا). ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar.

daas-irab:105-105.t: ﴿وَ﴾: resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ﴾: an imperative verb and its object; its fāʿil (agent) is omitted. ﴿لِلدِّينِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقم. ﴿حَنِيفاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَلا تَكُونَنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive (nāhiya), jussive-governing; تكونن is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of the jussive; its noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined).

daas-irab:106-106.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive (nāhiya), jussive-governing. ﴿تَدْعُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما لا﴾: mā is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); lā is negating. ﴿يَنْفَعُكَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَلا يَضُرُّكَ﴾: like the preceding. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿إن﴾: a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿فَعَلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَإِنَّكَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿إنك﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

daas-irab:107-107.t: ﴿وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation. ﴿كاشِفَ﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿لَهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the active participle كاشف; the khabar (predicate) is omitted. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, a badal (substitute) of the khabar of the lā of generic negation. ﴿وَإِنْ يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding. ﴿يُصِيبُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is omitted. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يصيب. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is omitted; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the clause يصيب is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يشاء. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾: its two khabars; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:108-108.t: ﴿قُلْ يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَكُمُ الْحَقُّ﴾: a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الحق. ﴿فَمَنِ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word is مَن]: a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اهْتَدى﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿إنما﴾: the restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained particle (makfūfa). ﴿يَهْتَدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يهتدي; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause فمن اهتدى is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّما يَضِلُّ عَلَيْها﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنَا﴾: a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وكيل. ﴿بِوَكِيلٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā; the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:109-109.t: ﴿وَاتَّبِعْ﴾: an imperative verb; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُوحى﴾: a passive imperfect verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يوحى; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of a relative. ﴿وَاصْبِرْ﴾: conjoined to اتبع. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and preposition. ﴿يَحْكُمَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition حتى, and the two are attached to اصبر. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَيْرُ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْحاكِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿الر﴾ these letters and their like have no grammatical position. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آياتُ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحَكِيمِ﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿أَكانَ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَجَباً﴾ the fronted khabar of kāna. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle that forms a maṣdar, makes the verb subjunctive and gives future sense. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); أن and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the delayed ism (subject) of kāna. ﴿إِلى رَجُلٍ﴾ the two are attached to أوحينا. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of رجل. ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative. ﴿أَنْذِرِ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَبَشِّرِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿قَدَمَ﴾ the ism of أنّ. ﴿صِدْقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ الْكافِرُونَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿أَنْ﴾ and then calls it «إن»; the Quranic text reads ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾.] ﴿هذا﴾ the hā is for alerting, and a demonstrative in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the ism of inna. ﴿لَساحِرٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ساحر is the khabar of inna. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ naʿt, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:3-4.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ inna and its ism (subject), and the Name of Majesty is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, naʿt (adjective). ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb and its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات, accusative like it. ﴿فِي سِتَّةِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to خلق. ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اسْتَوى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَى الْعَرْشِ﴾ the two are attached to استوى. ﴿يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil latent, and the clause is resumptive or circumstantial. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَفِيعٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿إِذْنِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكُمُ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām denotes distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿رَبَّكُمُ﴾ khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَاعْبُدُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is interrogative and لا is negating. ﴿تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَعْدَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَقًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its ism, and the clause is causal. ﴿يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِيَجْزِيَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation, and an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); أن and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to يعيده. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾ the two are attached to يجزي. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿شَرابٌ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿مِنْ حَمِيمٍ﴾ the two are attached to a naʿt of شراب. ﴿وَعَذابٌ﴾ conjoined to شراب. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ naʿt. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdar-forming. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism; the bāʾ and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar, are attached to a second naʿt of عذاب. ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:5-6.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ﴾ a past verb and its first object, the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ضِياءً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْقَمَرَ نُوراً﴾ conjoined to الشمس. ﴿وَقَدَّرَهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its first object, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنازِلَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِتَعْلَمُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation; an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it are attached (mutaʿalliq) to جعل. ﴿عَدَدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السِّنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿وَالْحِسابَ﴾ conjoined to السنين. [Translator's note: so in the source; الحساب is accusative and is conjoined to عدد.] ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi; the lām denotes distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُفَصِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to يفصل. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي اخْتِلافِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالنَّهارِ﴾ conjoined to الليل. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. [Translator's note: so in the source; here ما is the relative noun conjoined to اختلاف («and what Allah created»).] ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ the two are attached to خلق. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the ism (subject) of inna. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to a naʿt of آيات. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قوم.

daas-irab:7-9.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna, and the relative noun is its ism (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يَرْجُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لِقاءَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَرَضُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْحَياةِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to رضوا. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ naʿt (adjective), genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَاطْمَأَنُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to اطمأنوا. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to the الذين before it. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَنْ آياتِنا﴾ the two are attached to غافلون, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿غافِلُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām denotes distance and the kāf is for address, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿مَأْواهُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿النَّارُ﴾ khabar of مأواهم, and the clause is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is a relative noun; the two are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "وجوزوا" (and they were requited). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is the ism of inna, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿يَهْدِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿رَبُّهُمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بِإِيمانِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يهديهم, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ owing to heaviness. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ﴾ the two are attached to تجري, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿فِي جَنَّاتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿النَّعِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:10-11.t: ﴿دَعْواهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to دعواهم, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سُبْحانَكَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهُمَّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle whose place the mīm has taken; it is indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is a single proper name, in the position of accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to تحية. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَآخِرُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and آخر is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿دَعْواهُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنِ﴾ lightened from أنّ and given kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its ism (subject) is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause is the khabar of آخر. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is the khabar of أن. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; رب here is usually parsed as a naʿt or badal of the Name of Majesty.] ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿يُعَجِّلُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached to يعجل. ﴿الشَّرَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اسْتِعْجالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْخَيْرِ﴾ the two are attached to استعجالهم, and the clause is initial. ﴿لَقُضِيَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of لو, and a passive past verb. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to قضي. ﴿أَجَلُهُمْ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَنَذَرُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, its implied form being "فنمهلهم" (so We grant them respite). ﴿لا يَرْجُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لِقاءَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي طُغْيانِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يعمهون. ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial (a ḥāl).

daas-irab:12-13.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿مَسَّ الْإِنْسانَ الضُّرُّ﴾ a past verb, its fronted object and its delayed fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿دَعانا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility; نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لِجَنْبِهِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ قاعِداً أَوْ قائِماً﴾ conjoined to the omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لما is the temporal لما (al-ḥīniyya), an adverb of time. ﴿كَشَفْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ the two are attached to كشفنا. ﴿ضُرَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَرَّ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened from كأنّ; its ism (subject) is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause is circumstantial. ﴿لَمْ﴾ jussive-making. ﴿يَدْعُنا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter, and نا is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كأن. [Translator's note: so in the source; نا here is the object, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun.] ﴿إِلى ضُرٍّ﴾ the two are attached to يدعنا. ﴿مَسَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ضر. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive (majrūr); the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the lām denotes distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿زُيِّنَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾ the two are attached to زين. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿أَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of an oath. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to أهلكنا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ the temporal لما, an adverb of time. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَجاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ﴾ a past verb; the hāʾ is its fronted object, رسلهم is its delayed fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ the two are attached to جاءتهم. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿لِيُؤْمِنُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of denial, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it are attached to the omitted khabar of kāna. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is in the position of genitive; the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq; the lām denotes distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْقَوْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ naʿt, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:14-15.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿جَعَلْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿خَلائِفَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to خلائف. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to جعلنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِنَنْظُرَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation; an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by the implied أن after the lām of causation, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the lām and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) after it are attached to جعلناكم. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of ننظر. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿تُتْلى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to تتلى. ﴿آياتُنا﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾ ḥāl, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لا يَرْجُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لِقاءَنَا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ائْتِ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِقُرْآنٍ﴾ the two are attached to ائت. ﴿غَيْرِ﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿هذا﴾ the hā is for alerting, and the demonstrative is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ بَدِّلْهُ﴾ conjoined to ائت; the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿يَكُونُ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لِي﴾ the two are attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ﴾ subjunctive-making. ﴿أُبَدِّلَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive; the hāʾ is its object and the fāʿil is latent; أن and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as the ism (subject) of يكون. [Translator's note: so in the source; the ism of kāna is normally nominative, i.e. «in the position of nominative».] ﴿مِنْ تِلْقاءِ﴾ the two are attached to أبدله. ﴿نَفْسِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle of negation. [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿أَنْ﴾; the Quranic text reads ﴿إِنْ﴾.] ﴿أَتَّبِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُوحى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ the two are attached to يوحى, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its ism, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is the khabar of إني. ﴿أَنْ﴾ conditional. [Translator's note: again printed as ﴿أَنْ﴾ in the source; the Quranic text reads ﴿إِنْ﴾.] ﴿عَصَيْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is initial. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of أخاف. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ naʿt.

daas-irab:16-17.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is initial. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿تَلَوْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تلوته. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿أَدْراكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, the fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to أدراكم. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿لَبِثْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِيكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to لبثت. ﴿عُمُراً﴾ an adverb of time attached to لبثت. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ the two are attached to لبثت. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and لا is negating. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾ مَن is a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) by مِن, which is assimilated into it; the two are attached to أظلم. ﴿افْتَرى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to افترى. ﴿كَذِباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿كَذَّبَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِآياتِهِ﴾ the two are attached to كذب, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its ism (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُفْلِحُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:18-19.t: ﴿وَيَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يعبدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَضُرُّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلا يَنْفَعُهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it and parsed like it. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ the hā is for alerting, and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿شُفَعاؤُنا﴾ khabar (predicate), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to شفعاء. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَتُنَبِّئُونَ﴾ the hamza is interrogative; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source prints the Name with kasra here; as mafʿūl bihi it is ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ in the Quranic text.] ﴿بِما﴾ ما is a relative noun, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the two are attached to تنبئون. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَتَعالى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ ما is a relative noun, genitive by عن, and the two are attached to تعالى. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿كانَ النَّاسُ﴾ kāna and its ism (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أُمَّةً﴾ khabar. ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿فَاخْتَلَفُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لولا is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كَلِمَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, and the clause is initial. ﴿سَبَقَتْ﴾ a past verb, the tāʾ marks the feminine, the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is a naʿt. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ the two are attached to سبقت, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَقُضِيَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of لولا; a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to قضي, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فِيما﴾ ما is a relative noun, genitive by في, which is assimilated into it, and the two are attached to قضي. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to يختلفون. ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا. [Translator's note: so in the source; no كانوا occurs here, and the clause is the ṣila of ما.]

daas-irab:20-21.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. [Translator's note: so in the source; أنزل is a passive past verb.] ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أنزل. ﴿آيَةٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is initial. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية. ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the answer of لولا; an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ a restraining particle and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الْغَيْبُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿فَانْتَظِرُوا﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its ism (subject), and the clause is causal. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَذَقْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to رحمة. ﴿ضَرَّاءَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿مَسَّتْهُمْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ marks the feminine, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is a naʿt of ضراء. ﴿إِذا﴾ the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مَكْرٌ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي آياتِنا﴾ the two are attached to مكر, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُلِ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ أَسْرَعُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مَكْراً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿إِنَّ رُسُلَنا﴾ inna and its ism, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is causal. ﴿يَكْتُبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَمْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُسَيِّرُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي الْبَرِّ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يسيركم. ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾ conjoined to البر. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its ism (subject), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِي الْفُلْكِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَجَرَيْنَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil. ﴿بِهِمْ بِرِيحٍ﴾ attached to جرين. ﴿طَيِّبَةٍ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of ريح. ﴿وَفَرِحُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to فرحوا. ﴿جاءَتْها﴾ a past verb and its fronted object. ﴿رِيحٌ﴾ fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عاصِفٌ﴾ naʿt. ﴿وَجاءَهُمُ الْمَوْجُ﴾ a past verb, its fronted object and its delayed fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to جاءهم. ﴿مَكانٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَظَنُّوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ and its ism, and the clause takes the place of the two objects of ظن. ﴿أُحِيطَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to أحيط. ﴿دَعَوُا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُخْلِصِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to مخلصين. ﴿الدِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of مخلصين. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is conditional. ﴿أَنْجَيْتَنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is initial. ﴿مِنْ هذِهِ﴾ the demonstrative is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by من, and the two are attached to أنجيتنا; the hā is for alerting. ﴿لَنَكُونَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and the clause of the apodosis is omitted, the answer of the oath indicating it. [Translator's note: a stray «0» in the source text here has been left out.] ﴿مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar.

daas-irab:23-24.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and لما is the temporal لما (al-ḥīniyya), an adverb of time. ﴿أَنْجاهُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility; the hāʾ is its object and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِذا﴾ the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the answer of لما, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَبْغُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of هم. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يبغون. ﴿بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ﴾
the two are attached to يبغون, and الحق is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as vocative; the hā is for alerting. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ badal (substitute) of أيّ or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), and the vocative clause has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ a restraining particle and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿بَغْيُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَتاعَ﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ naʿt (adjective), genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَنُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾ ما is a relative noun, and the two are attached to ننبئكم. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its ism (subject), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ a restraining particle and the restrained particle. ﴿مَثَلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ naʿt, genitive with the kasra implied on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿كَماءٍ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is a naʿt of ماء. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ the two are attached to أنزلناه. ﴿فَاخْتَلَطَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to اختلط. ﴿نَباتُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ من is a preposition and ما is a relative noun; the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَأْكُلُ النَّاسُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَالْأَنْعامُ﴾ conjoined to الناس. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَخَذَتِ الْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the tāʾ marks the feminine and the hā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَازَّيَّنَتْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, the tāʾ marks the feminine, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَظَنَّ أَهْلُها﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil, the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ قادِرُونَ﴾ أنّ, its ism and its khabar, and the clause takes the place of the two objects of ظن. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ the two are attached to قادرون. ﴿أَتاها أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fronted object; أمرنا is the delayed fāʿil and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لَيْلًا﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿أَوْ نَهاراً﴾ conjoined to ليلا. ﴿فَجَعَلْناها حَصِيداً﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened from كأنّ; its ism is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause is circumstantial. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-making particle. ﴿تَغْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِالْأَمْسِ﴾ the two are attached to تغن. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is in the position of genitive by the kāf; the lām denotes distance and the kāf is for address; the two are attached to a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نُفَصِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to نفصل. ﴿يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قوم.
